paper_title: Chlorination-Mediated $\pi-\pi$ Stacking Enhances the Photodynamic Properties of a NIR-II Emitting Photosensitizer with Extended Conjugation
source_file: /home/wzfeng/MySearch/PhotoRag/MD/Angew Chem Int Ed - 2023 - Gu - Chlorination‐Mediated     Stacking Enhances the Photodynamic Properties of a NIR‐II/auto/Angew Chem Int Ed - 2023 - Gu - Chlorination‐Mediated     Stacking Enhances the Photodynamic Properties of a NIR‐II.md

knowledge_points.content: BMIC-BO-4Cl and BMIC-BO-4F are A-D-A type small-molecule photosensitizers utilizing a seven-ring-fused electron-donating core based on 1,2-dimethyl-1H-benzo[d]imidazole and halogenated indanone-based electron-withdrawing units.
knowledge_points.evidence: A new imidazole-involved seven-ring-fused electron-donating core was designed, and two A-D-A smallmolecular PSs, BMIC-BO-4Cl and BMIC-BO-4F with different halogen substitutions, were synthesized... The seven-ring-fused core based on 1,2-dimethyl-1H-benzo[d]imidazole was used as an electron-donating unit.

knowledge_points.content: BMIC-BO-4Cl and BMIC-BO-4F nanoparticles exhibit NIR-II fluorescence quantum yields of 2.29% and 2.33% respectively in the 900–1500 nm range, with emission tails extending beyond 1375 nm.
knowledge_points.evidence: both NPs displayed bright fluorescence in the NIR-II region with quantum yields (900-1500 nm) of 2.29% (BMIC-BO-4Cl NPs) and 2.33% (BMIC-BO-4F NPs)... with band tails beyond 1375 nm.

knowledge_points.content: The chlorination of the A-D-A photosensitizer BMIC-BO-4Cl results in a 1.7-fold higher reactive oxygen species (ROS) yield compared to its fluorinated counterpart BMIC-BO-4F and the previously reported COi6-4Cl.
knowledge_points.evidence: we observed that the ROS yield of BMICBO-4Cl nanoparticles (NPs) was about 1.7 times higher than that of COi6-4Cl and BMIC-BO-4F NPs... a notable 1.7-fold difference in ROS generation was observed between BMIC-BO-4Cl and BMIC-BO-4F NPs.

knowledge_points.content: Chlorination leads to more compact 3D network $\pi-\pi$ stacking in BMIC-BO-4Cl (frame dimensions 13.1 Å x 11.0 Å) compared to the looser packing in fluorinated BMIC-BO-4F (22.5 Å x 20.8 Å).
knowledge_points.evidence: BMIC-BO-4Cl molecules were arranged into a very compact ellipse-like 3D network packing structure... with a frame dimension of Lx = 13.1 Å and Ly = 11.0 Å... BMIC-BO-4F formed a rectangular-like 3D network packing structure... with a frame dimension of Lx = 22.5 Å and Ly = 20.8 Å.

knowledge_points.content: The enhanced PDT efficiency in BMIC-BO-4Cl is attributed to more efficient charge separation and transfer, supported by a photocurrent density twice as high and a smaller charge transfer resistance compared to BMIC-BO-4F.
knowledge_points.evidence: the photocurrent density of BMIC-BO-4Cl was two times higher than that of BMIC-BO-4F... The BMIC-BO-4Cl film exhibited a smaller semicircle than BMIC-BO-4F, corresponding to a more efficient charge transfer.

knowledge_points.content: The energy levels for BMIC-BO-4Cl are $E_{HOMO}$ = -5.18 eV and $E_{LUMO}$ = -3.78 eV, while for BMIC-BO-4F they are $E_{HOMO}$ = -5.17 eV and $E_{LUMO}$ = -3.74 eV.
knowledge_points.evidence: Specifically, the E_HOMO / E_LUMO values of BMIC-BO-4Cl and BMIC-BO-4F are -5.18 / -3.78 and -5.17 / -3.74 eV, respectively.

knowledge_points.content: The photoexcited holes of BMIC-BO-4Cl and BMIC-BO-4F have oxidation potentials of 3.83 V and 3.72 V (vs NHE, pH=7), respectively, which are sufficiently positive to oxidize $H_2O$ into hydroxyl radicals (.OH) at 1.99 V.
knowledge_points.evidence: the oxidating potentials (vs. NHE, pH=7) of the photoexcited holes of BMIC-BO-4Cl and BMIC-BO-4F were 3.83 V and 3.72 V... more positive than the oxidation potential of H2O (1.99 V vs. NHE, pH=7), which indicates that the photo-excited holes of BMIC-BO-4Cl/F can theoretically oxidize H2O into .OH.

knowledge_points.content: Type-I and Type-II PDT mechanisms were confirmed via electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) spectroscopy, detecting characteristic signals for DMPO/·OH, TEMP/$^1O_2$, and BMPO/$O_2^{\cdot -}$ adducts.
knowledge_points.evidence: The characteristic 1:2:2:1 EPR signal of DMPO/·OH adduct, the typical 1:1:1 triplet signal of TEMP/1O2 adduct, and the hyperfine splits of BMPO/O2·- adduct... were observed when 5 min laser irradiation was performed on both NPs.

knowledge_points.content: Nanoparticles were fabricated using the nanoprecipitation method with a $PCL_{3500}-b-PEG_{2000}$ polymer matrix, resulting in hydrodynamic diameters of approximately 50 nm for BMIC-BO-4Cl and 40 nm for BMIC-BO-4F.
knowledge_points.evidence: BMIC-BO-4Cl and BMICBO-4F NPs were prepared by the nanoprecipitation method with poly(e-caprolactone)3500-b-poly(ethylene glycol)2000... Hydrodynamic diameters for BMIC-BO-4Cl and BMIC-BO-4F NPs are around 50 and 40 nm, respectively.

knowledge_points.content: BMIC-BO-4Cl and BMIC-BO-4F nanoparticles exhibit high colloidal stability with zeta potentials around -15 mV and maintain stable sizes for up to 30 days in water.
knowledge_points.evidence: the two NPs showed zeta potentials around -15 mV... which could keep size unchanged for up to 30 days in H2O indicating their good colloidal stability.

knowledge_points.content: In vivo NIR-II fluorescence imaging using a 1319 nm long-pass filter achieved a signal-to-background ratio (SBR) of 2.8 for hindlimb vessel imaging, significantly higher than those achieved with 1100 nm or 1250 nm filters.
knowledge_points.evidence: The SBR values for hindlimb vessel imaging under the 1319 nm LP filter reached 2.8. On the other side, the imaging contrast (SBR values decreased to ~1.5–1.7) was significantly compromised if 1100 and 1250 nm LP filters were used.

knowledge_points.content: Single-crystal analysis reveals that Cl atoms exhibit strong Cl...N interactions (3.43 Å) with imidazole units in BMIC-BO-4Cl, whereas F atoms in BMIC-BO-4F lack similar interactions (F...N distance of 5.48 Å).
knowledge_points.evidence: the Cl atoms showed strong Cl...N interactions with the imidazole units, leading to nearly parallel... and close pi-pi stackings (pi-pi distance of 3.43 Å... for BMIC-BO-4F, the F--N distance was 5.48 Å... indicated the lack of F--N interactions.
